'''2020 EGP Scott Lingrell LS You Can Either Profit By This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2020 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Scott Lingrell]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open You Can Either Profit By This Lingr.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20200804023225/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-endor-grand-prix/ Internet Archive]
